run_metadata.model_substitution_reason: Original evaluation model (Gemini 2.0 Flash) deprecated and unavailable via API. Both predicted and oracle conditions were re-run with Claude Haiku to ensure internal consistency of the delta.

source_data_path.note: Exact same 60 case IDs as AgentErrorBench evaluation in paper Table 2/3 (20 ALFWorld, 20 GAIA, 20 WebShop). GT labels loaded from data/shielda_ground_truth/

run_metadata.log_truncation: Agent execution logs truncated to last 8,000 characters before passing to simulator and judge, to fit within Claude Haiku 200k-token context window. Truncation applied identically across both conditions.
run_metadata.notes: No cases missing from either condition. All 60 cases have both predicted and oracle results. Three earlier runs (1233, 1304, 1305) were invalidated: 1233 had context-overflow errors on GAIA cases (no truncation applied); 1304 and 1305 failed with API authentication errors. Only the 1404 pair is used here.
